## Ethical Framework (DSEI)
Seven structural principles — if an ethical test fails, the build fails:
1. Honest Refusal — refuse rather than confabulate
2. Concordance Transparency — show agreement percentage between engines
3. Human Escalation — escalate when exceeding competence
4. Anti-Addiction — hard-stop for minors
5. Data Minimisation — log events, not persons
6. Manipulation Detection — 6-axis independent scoring
7. Human Anchor — every AI chain traces to signed human intent
